headline: Is Ford’s Valencia EV Joint Venture With Geely Reshaping The Investment Case For Ford Motor (F)?
summary: Ford Motor Company recently announced it will form a Europe-focused manufacturing joint venture with Geely Automobile at Ford’s Valencia, Spain plant, aiming to build low- and zero-emission vehicles for both brands from 2028 while maintaining current Kuga production.
